# Background photos

Bundled as `dist/nuvio-bg-<id>-{wide,portrait,thumb}.webp`.

## Default background (`default`)

`nuvio-bg-default-wide.webp` (1920×1280) and `nuvio-bg-default-portrait.webp` (1080×1920 crop) are resized from:

- **House in forest** (Kersko, Hradištko, Czechia), photo by **Flo Pappert** ([unsplash.com/@flopt](https://unsplash.com/@flopt))
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:House_in_forest_(Unsplash).jpg (originally https://unsplash.com/photos/kspRwqFxOms, published 2017 under the Unsplash CC0 licence)
- Licence: **CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)**, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No attribution is legally required; it is given here as a courtesy.


# Background photos

All ten photos are **CC0 1.0 Universal** (public domain dedication, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), published on Unsplash before June 2017 under the Unsplash CC0 licence and mirrored on Wikimedia Commons. They may be redistributed and modified; attribution is given as a courtesy.

Each id has `<id>-wide.webp` (1920 px, ≤250 KB), `<id>-portrait.webp` (900×1600, ≤120 KB) and `<id>-thumb.webp` (240×150).
